text:
mina: Quick sync: product asked for a lightweight decision on how we handle locale-heavy customers during the v1->v2 catalog migration. Need a crisp policy we can include in the migration playbook.
raj: Suggestion: default soft-migration with opt-in hard pin. Soft-migration = traffic routed to v2 unless customer requests pin. Provide paid pin extensions for sensitive customers.
sara: We have to define 'soft' quantitatively. my proposal: two-tier sampling + semantic gate. Tier A (core intents): 250 samples per locale; Tier B (rare intents): 50 samples. Run embed-sim and response-length-preservation checks.
mike: Important infra note: v2 changes KV layout which makes a direct fallback to v1 expensive. fallback should be treated as emergency-only. For normal rollouts we should keep a v1-compat shim that mimics v1 kv semantics to avoid heavy rehosting.
mina: Can we sketch the shim config? I want something minimal that product can sign-off on.
raj: Pseudo-config like: ```{"cohort":"apac-local-1","rollout":"soft","shim":"v1-kv-compat","pin_grace_days":14,"sampling":{"core":250,"edge":50}}```
sara: For metrics: use adjusted cosine similarity on normalized embeddings; threshold = 0.86 for auto-pass, 0.80 auto-fail, anything in between flagged for human review. Also track ROUGE-L change > 0.12 as a regression for long-form.
mike: Rollback / abort criteria from infra: sustained client 5xx > 0.8% for 30m OR 10% higher cost per token sustained for 12h OR embed-sim drop >0.06 on rolling 6h window. Those are conservative but protect customers.
mina: Operational cadence: start canary 5% for 24h, 20% for 72h, then 100% if gates pass. For large cohorts (>10k qpm) do 48h at each step.
raj: We need clear comms options: timeline, opt-out link, a form to request a paid extension. I'll draft the copy.
sara: Human review flow: ops will surface flagged samples, product will coordinate reviewers with a short rubric: fidelity to prompt, cultural appropriateness, hallucination severity. We should keep review windows <48h.
mike: Capacity: reserve a small hot pool for shm-compat shims: 1 GPU per 5k qpm of pinned traffic. autoscale baseline + 2x for first 36h during ramp.
mina: Billing integration: expose metadata: pin_reason, pin_expires_at, shim_enabled. That requires a small billing API change — mike, can infra add a webhook field?
mike: yes, will add `pin_metadata` into usage events; need 2-week lead to coordinate billing.
raj: Decision item: do we let customer self-serve pin via dashboard? pros: less ops; cons: abuse/latency. I'm inclined to yes with a review flag for >30 days extension.
sara: Strong +1 to self-serve for short pins (<=21 days). Anything longer should require request + review.
mina: OK decision: self-serve pins up to 21 days; paid reviewed extensions beyond that. I'll add to playbook.
deploy-bot: canary-status: cohort apac-local-1 stepped to 5% at 2026-03-23T09:04:00Z.
raj: noted. I'll add monitoring dashboards for embed-sim drift and ROUGE-L delta.
mina: owners & deliverables: bench harness sampling matrix = sara by EOD Wed; shim config and billing schema = mike by EOD Fri; user comms + opt-out UX = raj by next Tue.
sara: I'll also add a small synthetic augmentation set for low-volume locales to avoid brittle metrics.
mike: One more: ensure streaming API surface unchanged. If we detect signature change, we must ship a 2.1 shim in the SDK.
mina: Great. I'll assemble a 1-pager and drop in #product. speak up if thresholds need tuning.
raj: all good from me.
sara: LGTM
mike: 👍
mina: Closing thread. Thanks everyone.
